Three reviewers scored 23 blind items with a fixed 12-row real-negative denominator. attacks_that_broke_claim: Real denominator label leakage broke the fixed-denominator policy: H-665, H-158, M-527, M-1315, and M-171 were flagged by reviewers A and B; reviewer C flagged four of those five.
Reviewer C produced conservative target-like uncertainty on two real negatives: M-525 and M-365.
Targets were not cleanly recovered: M-1320, H-654, and M-811 failed or were uncertain across reviewers; M-1310 passed for A/B but failed for C.
Inter-review target counts varied for M-1320 (8/8/7), M-1310 (7/7/6), and M-811 (5/6/6).
The packet still did not test physical source direction or source side; it only tested blind crop boxability, leakage, and token-count recovery.
skeptic_record.residual_value: v2b is useful as a stricter packet generator and a documented failure mode: OCR word-box masking of route-context crops does not reliably remove neighboring catalogue labels. Future packets must use true object-panel segmentation or manual label-free crops before blind review.
